refreshNotes: All-new launch year for the Q6 e-tron on the PPE platform. Three trims: Premium ($63,800), Premium Plus ($68,600), Prestige ($70,600). 800V architecture, 270 kW DC fast charging. EPA range up to 321 mi (single-motor RWD) or 307 mi (quattro). NACS adapter began shipping as port-installed accessory September 2025. Sources: https://cars.usnews.com/cars-trucks/audi/q6-e-tron ; https://media.audiusa.com/releases/643
